title: The sky won’t whisper your name.
paragraphs:
The sky won’t whisper your name.
It will expose it.

Because deep down…
we already know what’s hiding in the dark.
You saw the lightning in that image.

That man—frozen between fear and realization—
isn’t just looking at the sky.
Because we’ve mastered the art of appearing okay.

Church face.
Filtered faith.
Polished words.

Secret compromises.
Silent sins we think no one notices.
And we tell ourselves, “Later. I’ll fix it later.”
It forces truth into the open.
Jesus didn’t describe His return gently.

In Matthew 24:27, He said:
“For as lightning comes from the east and shines as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.”
And here’s where it hits hard—

Lightning doesn’t just light the sky.
It exposes everything underneath it.

The pride you justified.
The lust you hid.
The bitterness you fed.
The compromise you renamed as “normal.”
And suddenly, what was hidden… is undeniable.
That’s why the man in the image is trembling.
We don’t fear God’s return because we don’t believe it.
We fear it because we know…

God is not mocked.
Sin is not invisible.
And holiness is not optional.

Galatians 6:7 says:
“Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also reap.”

You plant secrecy—
you reap exposure.

You plant pride—
you reap distance from God.

You plant sin—
you reap death.

Romans 6:23 says it plainly:
“For the wages of sin is death…”
And that’s where most people stop.
“…but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.”

Because the same God who warns you with lightning…
also reached for you with nails.
You don’t clean yourself up to meet Jesus.
You run to Him while you’re still exposed.
Because Jesus didn’t come for the polished.

1 John 1:9 says:
“If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”
And yes… it costs your pride.
Some scholars interpret the “lightning” in Matthew 24 not only as speed and visibility, but as divine revelation—God making everything known in an instant.
What will His light reveal in you?

Because one day—
the sky will split.

And in that moment,
there will be two kinds of people:
And those who run toward Him.
Because they’ve already stepped into the light before the lightning came.

John 3:19-21 says:
“Light has come into the world, and people loved the darkness rather than the light because their works were evil… But whoever does what is true comes to the light…”
Coming into the light is a choice.
What are you still pretending God doesn’t see?
Jesus took your exposure on the cross.

So that when lightning comes—
you don’t have to fear judgment.
